verdict.rationale: Cancelling or correcting a submitted payroll is a fair question for a payroll product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows pre-submission accuracy aids: Intelligent Pay Cycle flags issues, and Paychex Pre-check lets employees review paychecks in advance. These are adjacent features, not documented cancellation, voiding or correction of an already-submitted payroll before payday.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can cancel or correct a submitted payroll before employees are paid
